_comment: Shared fixture for the id of an on-disk local model that has no registry entry: <family>/<artifact as the provider lists it>. Read by wt/internal/litellm/discovered_ids_fixture_test.go (Go, litellm.DiscoveredModel) and modelman/tests/contracts/test_discovered_ids_fixture.py (Python, local_control._discovered_id). The two must agree: the LiteLLM route wt writes, modelman's running flag and `modelman stop <id>`, and wt's usage and survey history all key on this string. mlx_lm_server has no case because a pairing is never discovered.
